overview: Oxidative stress occurs when harmful free radicals outweigh the body's antioxidant defenses, leading to gradual damage of cells and tissues. Over time, this imbalance may contribute to aging and increase the risk of several chronic diseases.

Include nuts, seeds, and healthy fats.

Prefer whole foods over antioxidant supplements.
exercise_recommendations: Aim for 150–300 minutes of aerobic activity weekly.

Monitor waist circumference if needed.
Review lifestyle habits during routine health visits.
